reviewNotes: Twenty-five diary, naming, location, shop, mine, command, clock, pause, and fishing-minigame strings were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover placeholders, established backpack and token names, cipher-text preservation, fragment usability, time notation, capitalization, punctuation, and concise UI wording; both found no remaining objective issue.
